facts.fact: Kenya's Health Cabinet Secretary said the digitisation of the Comprehensive Integrated Health Information System is led by the Digital Health Agency under the Ministry of Health.
The Cabinet Secretary said the Afya Yangu platform now enables portability of patient data across health facilities.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health / Digital Health Agency

facts.fact: The Cabinet Secretary said regulatory bodies like KMPDC have been fully integrated with the health information system, and Afya Yangu enables patient data portability across facilities.
The Cabinet Secretary said the Comprehensive Integrated Health Information System is operational in 17 counties, with rollout to Homabay, Kisumu, Nakuru, Lamu and others in the coming weeks.
